page.layout: One column of running text, with the title "PRÆFATIO." centred above it at full width. Nothing in the margins. At the bottom right, the catchword.

p.i: Ecclesiarumque ministros, ut hanc modestam & veram doctrinam fidis animis custodiant; & caveant sibi à fermento ac supercilio Pontificio, atque à Novitatibus.

Potuissem autem materiam hanc latissimè deducere; sed volui Disputationem illam repetere & quidem sine ulla mutatione, additione, detractione, ne quis calumniari posset me ante hac aliter docuisse et scripsisse, quàm nunc; quamvis si in melius proficere potuissem, nemo nisi perfrictæ frontis homo id mihi objicere posset.

page.notes: The catchword at the foot is set in the same italic and is hard to read; I have given it as "ctrina" with a doubt mark. The running text ends with "do-" hyphenated at the line end, and the word continues on the catchword line as "ctrina". The long s is printed as f-like forms throughout and is rendered here as s. The "et" is set as a ligature. No page number is printed.
